verdict.rationale: Gemini's 'Notebooks' feature explicitly lets users organize projects into a dedicated space, remembering sources, instructions, and ongoing discussions, and users can upload documents/files as sources — directly matching the story of grouping related chats and files with shared context/instructions. Custom Gems further support persistent instruction-driven contexts. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration specifically validating multi-chat organization within a single space, and clarity on limits of shared context across chats within a notebook.
